lead: The Best Bakery case was a legal case involving the burning down of the Best Bakery, a small outlet in the Hanuman Tekri area in Vadodara, Gujarat, India, on 1 March 2002. This case has come to symbolize the carnage in 2002 Gujarat riots that followed the Godhra train burning. title: 1986 Nauruan parliamentary election
